01 / The context

A campaign with a clear role.

A finance-news app needed awareness and downloads among a relevant student audience at Michigan Ross.

I executed a campus marketing stunt at Michigan Ross for Flow Finance, an iOS app developed by Arjun Mayur. The campaign reported 1,200 impressions and a 33% increase in downloads. The app provides financial news with concise, AI-generated summaries.
